meta.title: Rust Academy
meta.description: Industry-grade Rust curriculum in the sidebar: six tracks from language fundamentals to production web services (axum), data and persistence (SQLx, Redis), microservices and messaging (tonic, Kafka, NATS), process handling and workers, and platform work (observability, Kubernetes, CI/CD) — with exercises, production checklists, architecture blueprints, and a cheatsheet.
